description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise on Main Street in Penticton offering takeout and delivery of pizza, wings, salads, and sides. The brand highlights antibiotic-free meat, organic tomato sauce, and daily fresh dough, and explicitly carries vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-smart options. As a fast-food takeout operation, it provides a quick and accessible meal stop for cyclists passing through central Penticton.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Penticton Panago location at 1848 Main St with postal code V2A 5H3, consistent with OSM tags. The website explicitly states 'Panago offers vegan, vegetarian and gluten-smart options,' confirming dietary variety. OSM tag takeaway=yes and the website's online ordering interface confirm takeout availability; no evidence exists in either source for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website shows national ordering number 310-0001 rather than a direct local line.
Required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unverifiable from the website content — an in-person check is needed before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active national fast-food chain franchise useful to cyclists for takeout and dietary options, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence.
